N.description: int. Dimension of the rows of the returned array.

M.description: optional, int. Dimension of the columns of the returned array. If not specified, then ``M = N``.

k.description: optional, int, default=0. Specifies the sub-diagonal on and below which the array is filled with ones. ``k=0`` refers to main diagonal, ``k<0`` refers to sub-diagonal below the main diagonal and ``k>0`` refers to sub-diagonal above the main diagonal.

dtype.description: optional, data type of the returned array. The default type is float.

output.description: An array of shape ``(N, M)`` containing the lower triangle with elements below the sub-diagonal specified by ``k`` are set to one and zero elsewhere.
